response.sql: WITH v AS (SELECT COALESCE(p.death_country,'') AS death_country, CAST(a.points_won AS REAL)/a.points_max AS share FROM player_award_vote a JOIN player p ON p.player_id = a.player_id WHERE a.points_max IS NOT NULL AND a.points_max <> 0 AND a.points_won IS NOT NULL), c AS (SELECT death_country, AVG(share) AS avg_share FROM v GROUP BY death_country) SELECT death_country, avg_share, avg_share / (SELECT AVG(avg_share) FROM c) AS relative_ratio FROM c ORDER BY death_country

assumptions.assumption: Award votes come from player_award_vote (manager_award_vote is for managers and has no link to player), inner-joined to player on player_id.
A blank country means a NULL or empty death_country (e.g. living players). Both are put in one group shown as an empty string.

Each country's figure is the unweighted mean of per-vote points_won/points_max. Votes with NULL or zero points_max, or NULL points_won, are skipped. The ratio divides by the simple mean of the country figures, not a vote-weighted mean.
